statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The patient has known sick sinus syndrome
The patient has a history of atherosclerotic heart disease
The patient has intermittent symptomatic arrhythmias
The diagnosis codes I49.5, I25.10, and I47.1 were submitted
The service was denied under reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that the service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
Cardiac event monitoring is medically necessary to correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances and guide further management
